title: When KV Meets Embeddings: Dynamic GPU Memory Allocation for Accelerating Generative Recommender Serving
abstract: arXiv:2605.04450v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative Recommender (GR) inference places embedding hot caches (EMB) and KV caches in direct competition for limited GPU HBM: allocating more memory to one improves its efficiency but degrades the other. Existing systems optimize them in isolation, overlooking that the optimal EMB-KV allocation ratio can shift by up to 0.35 across workload regimes, leaving 20-30\% latency improvement unrealized. While online reallocation is required to close this gap, naive approaches introduce H2D refill traffic on the critical path, causing P99 SLO violations.   To address this, we present RACER, which jointly manages HBM allocation and request routing at runtime through two key components: (1) Adaptive Memory Allocation, a three-layer PPO-based controller (frozen base policy, online residual adapter, and burst-aware recovery controller) that achieves $32\,\mathrm{\mu s}$ decision latency while staying within 0.024-0.029 of the offline-opt

translated_title: 当KV遇见嵌入：动态GPU内存分配以加速生成式推荐系统服务
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）推理将嵌入热缓存（EMB）和KV缓存置于对有限GPU HBM的直接竞争中：为其中一个分配更多内存会提升其效率，但会降低另一个的效率。现有系统孤立地优化它们，忽视了最优的EMB-KV分配比例在不同工作负载场景下可能变化高达0.35，导致20-30%的延迟改进未能实现。虽然在线重新分配是缩小这一差距所必需的，但朴素的方法会在关键路径上引入H2D重填流量，导致P99服务级别目标（SLO）违规。为解决此问题，我们提出了RACER，它通过两个关键组件在运行时联合管理HBM分配和请求路由：（1）自适应内存分配，一个基于PPO的三层控制器（冻结基础策略、在线残差适配器和突发感知恢复控制器），实现了32微秒的决策延迟，同时保持在离线最优值的0.024-0.029范围内。
tldr: RACER通过一个三层PPO控制器在运行时动态分配GPU内存给嵌入和KV缓存，并联合请求路由，以最小化生成式推荐系统的延迟，避免了传统方法中的H2D重填流量和SLO违规。
en_tdlr: RACER dynamically allocates GPU memory between embedding and KV caches at runtime via a three-layer PPO controller with joint request routing, minimizing latency for generative recommender systems while avoiding H2D refill traffic and SLO violations.
